Data.subject: Services
Data.topic: Annual Services Statistics - All Services Industries
Data.title: Growth Rate Of Top 3 Business Cost Drivers By Industry Group, Ownership And Type Of Enterprise In All Services Industries, Annual
Data.footnote: The top 3 business cost drivers refer to the three detailed business cost items with the largest share of total business costs in the latest reference year, identified for each detailed cut (Overall/ Type of Ownership/ Type of Enterprise) for each industry. Where the latest figures are influenced by transient factors that are not expected to persist, the ranking may be kept consistent with the previous year. Business cost refers to operating expenditure excluding purchases of goods & materials and depreciation but including skills development funds contributions and workforce-related subsidies. Labour cost includes remuneration (comprising wages & salaries , employer’s contribution to CPF and pension funds, stock options & other share-based payments and staff benefits), foreign workers levy and skills development funds contributions. Non-Labour Production Taxes includes taxes on production such as road tax, property tax etc. Professional services comprises accounting, management consultancy, legal, engineering, architectural and other professional services. Utilities comprises covers water, electricity & gas. Financial services comprises includes charges on bank & financial services and insurance premiums on property and equipment. Local enterprises refer to enterpries with at least 50% local equity. Foreign enterprises refer to enterprises with less than 50% local equity.
